claims: The Artemis II mission will reach speeds of approximately 17,000 mph (27,000 km/h) to enter Earth orbit.
During its return from the Moon, the Orion capsule will hit a peak reentry speed of over 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h).
The peak reentry speed of the Orion capsule during its return from the Moon is roughly 32 times the speed of sound.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket accelerates to over 3,100 mph within the first two minutes.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket hits around 17,000 mph to reach orbit.
Further burns increase the speed to over 22,000 mph to escape Earth's gravity.
The spacecraft hits the atmosphere at 25,000 mph.
The Artemis II crew will technically become the fastest-traveling humans in history upon their return.
The Artemis II crew will surpass the speeds of Apollo 10 upon their return.
